what: Amcor makes packaging: flexible films and pouches for food, medical and pharmaceutical products, and rigid plastic containers for drinks and personal care. It merged with Berry Global in 2025.
customers: Food and beverage companies, healthcare and pharmaceutical manufacturers, and personal care brands worldwide.
money: films, pouches and laminates for food and healthcare
moat: Packaging qualified into customers' filling lines and, for medical products, into regulatory filings, which makes changing supplier slow and risky.
risks: Debt of about $16 billion after the Berry merger
Net margin of about 5% is thin
Resin costs are volatile and pass through with a lag
Plastic packaging faces regulatory pressure in Europe and elsewhere
opportunities: Revenue grew about 57% last year as the merger took effect
Large cost synergies from combining two of the biggest packaging companies
watch: Synergy delivery from the Berry merger and organic volume growth.
